correction: A `.history/<v>/` index pair in `isos/native/v1/` does not always belong to a `snosi-installer` ISO: promote.sh archived every outgoing index of the earlier `snosi-native-installer` channel into the same namespace. Retention must delete a pair only together with the installer ISO of the same version in the same run, never because the version is merely outside the keep window.
evidence: Owner review of PR #1287 at 7a7b7f7: a dry run listed `.history/20260801000000/SHA256SUMS{,.gpg}` for deletion beside kept `snosi-native-installer_20260801000000_x86-64.iso`. With the fixture added and the fix reverted, test/iso-retention-test.sh fails ('dry run counts 10 deletions', 'execute exits 0'); with the fix it passes.
